findings.title: Bed filter on Waterings page is lost on reload / shared link (URL writes bed_id, page reads bed)
findings.steps: Open /waterings, choose a bed in the Bed filter. The URL becomes /waterings?bed_id=2. Reload the page or open that URL directly.
findings.expected: The page opens filtered to the chosen bed, same as via the 'Watering history' link (?bed=2).
findings.actual: The page reads route.query.bed but the watcher writes {bed_id}, so after reload the filter resets to 'All beds' and all waterings are shown.
findings.evidence: curl http://localhost:3791/waterings?bed=2 renders <option value="2" selected>Shade corner and '1 watering, 4 L in total'; curl /waterings?bed_id=2 renders <option value="" selected>All beds and '5 waterings'.

findings.title: Watering endpoints return 500 for out-of-range integer ids and non-finite litres
findings.actual: 500 Internal Server Error (SQLite integer overflow; 1e400 parsed as inf)
findings.evidence: All four requests answered 'Internal Server Error' with HTTP 500.

findings.title: No request timeout: 'Water now' / 'Save watering' / Delete can stay 'Watering…'/'Saving…' forever
findings.steps: Make the API hang (slow network or stalled server) and click 'Water now' or 'Save watering'.
findings.expected: Request fails after 10 s with a visible error, button re-enabled.
findings.actual: No timeout is configured on $fetch.create or useFetch, so the button stays disabled with 'Watering…' indefinitely and list pages stay 'Loading waterings…'.
findings.evidence: grep for 'timeout' in frontend/app and nuxt.config returns nothing; recordWatering awaits api() without a timeout.

findings.title: Recording a watering is not idempotent; retry after timeout/lost response creates duplicates
findings.where: POST /api/waterings, Beds page 'Water now' and 'Save watering'
findings.steps: Click 'Water now'; response is lost or times out after the server committed; user clicks again.
findings.actual: Each POST inserts a new row; there is no idempotency key or dedupe, so two waterings are logged. Same for re-submitting the past-watering form after an error.
findings.evidence: create_watering always INSERTs; frontend sends no request id.

findings.title: Waterings page and dashboard 'Recent waterings' error states have no retry
findings.steps: Stop the API (or make /api/waterings fail), open /waterings or the dashboard, then bring the API back.
findings.expected: Error message with a Retry button that reloads the data without a page reload.
findings.actual: Only an AlertMessage is shown; no retry control (dashboard doesn't even destructure refresh for waterings). User must reload the page or change the filter.
findings.evidence: index.vue: const { data: waterings, error: wateringsError } = wateringsResult; template has AlertMessage only. waterings.vue error AlertMessage has no button.

findings.title: Bed list failure on Waterings page is silently swallowed; filter shows only 'All beds'
findings.steps: Have GET /api/beds fail while /api/waterings succeeds; open /waterings?bed=2.
findings.expected: A visible error that beds could not be loaded, with retry.
findings.actual: bedsResult.error is never read; the select shows only 'All beds' (no matching option for the active filter) with no explanation.
findings.evidence: const { data: beds } = bedsResult — error ignored; options rendered from beds ?? [].

findings.title: Waterings table overflows 375 px with long bed names
findings.steps: Create a bed with a 60-character name without spaces, water it, view /waterings at 375 px width.
findings.actual: Table cells have no overflow-wrap/word-break and the table is not in a scroll container, so the 4-column row (date+time, name, amount, Delete) exceeds 375 px and the page scrolls sideways.
findings.evidence: main.css has no overflow-wrap/word-break rules; .table is width:100% with no table-layout or wrapping.

findings.title: 'Today' rejected as future date for users ahead of the server's time zone; date and time computed in different zones
findings.where: Beds page 'Record past watering' form; POST /api/waterings
findings.steps: As a user whose local date is already the next day relative to the server (e.g. UTC+9 late evening while server is CET), submit the form with the default date (today).
findings.actual: Client defaults/max to its local today (todayIso), server validates against server-local date.today() and answers 'Watering date cannot be in the future.' Also 'Water now' stores watered_on in server local date but watered_at in UTC, so list ordering/date can disagree with the time shown to the viewer.
findings.evidence: schemas.WateringIn.not_in_future uses date.today(); waterings.create_watering uses now.astimezone().date() for watered_on and UTC for watered_at.

findings.title: Deleting a watering twice (retry after timeout) shows an error though the watering was deleted
findings.steps: Delete a watering, response is lost, retry the delete.
findings.expected: Second delete is a no-op success.
findings.actual: Second DELETE returns 404 'Watering not found.' which is shown as an error.

findings.title: Implausible past dates accepted (e.g. year 0001)
findings.expected: Refused with a visible reason (no lower bound).
findings.actual: 201 Created; the entry appears in the log.
